title: Ram Bhawan Singh v. Chief Managing Director, U.P. Power Corp.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta, J.; Mukhtar Ahmad, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner relegated to CGRF under clause 7.10.
headnote: A writ seeking to restrain further electricity connections from an installed 63 KVA transformer was disposed of, leaving the petitioner to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Ram Bhawan Singh petitioned the Allahabad High Court under Article 226 seeking a direction that the Executive Engineer, Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation, Poorvanchal Electric Distribution Division, Fatehpur, should not grant further electricity connections from a 63 KVA transformer already installed. Counsel for the Corporation submitted that the grievance could be taken to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under paragraph 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: CGRF as forum for grievance against further connections from a transformer
holding_units.holding: Where a consumer objects to the licensee releasing further connections from an installed transformer, that grievance is to be raised before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum as contemplated in clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the High Court will dispose of the writ leaving that statutory remedy open.

not_decided.point: Whether further electricity connections could lawfully be released from the 63 KVA transformer
not_decided.note: Left to the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under clause 7.10
